581: // Update handles UI updates
582: func (m Model) Update(msg tea.Msg) (tea.Model, tea.Cmd) {
583: 	var cmd tea.Cmd
584: 	var cmds []tea.Cmd
585: 
586: 	switch msg := msg.(type) {
587: 	case tea.KeyMsg:
588: 		switch msg.Type {
589: 		case tea.KeyCtrlC:
590: 			return m, tea.Quit
591: 		}
592: 
593: 	case tea.MouseMsg:
594: 		cmds = append(cmds, m.handleMouse(msg))
595: 
596: 	case tea.WindowSizeMsg:
597: 		m, cmd = m.handleResize(msg)
598: 		cmds = append(cmds, cmd)
599: 
600: 	case updateResourceDataMsg:
601: 		m.ResourceData = msg.data
602: 		cmds = append(cmds, m.updateResourceData())
603: 
604: 	case AppendLogMsg:
605: 		m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, msg.Log)
606: 		GetLogger().Write(msg.Log + "\n")
607: 		if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
608: 			m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
609: 		}
610: 		m.updateLogView()
611: 		// Continue polling for more logs if server is starting
612: 		if m.ServerStarting && !m.ServerReady {
613: 			cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
614: 				return pollServerLogsMsg{}
615: 			}))
616: 		}
617: 
618: 	case pollServerLogsMsg:
619: 		// Poll for more logs from the channel
620: 		if m.ServerStarting && !m.ServerReady {
621: 			select {
622: 			case log := <-m.LogChan:
623: 				m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, log)
624: 				GetLogger().Write(log + "\n")
625: 				if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
626: 					m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
627: 				}
628: 				m.updateLogView()
629: 
630: 				// Check if server is now ready (message contains "is ready")
631: 				if strings.Contains(log, "is ready") {
632: 					// Trigger health check to update ServerReady state
633: 					cmds = append(cmds, m.checkServerHealth())
634: 				}
635: 			default:
636: 				// No log available, just continue
637: 			}
638: 			// Continue polling
639: 			cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
640: 				return pollServerLogsMsg{}
641: 			}))
642: 		}
643: 
644: 	case pollPipelineLogsMsg:
645: 		if m.PipelineRunning {
646: 			// Drain as many logs as possible in one tick to keep up with fast output
647: 			drained := 0
648: 			maxDrain := 20 // Process up to 20 logs per tick to avoid blocking the UI
649: 			for drained < maxDrain {
650: 				select {
651: 				case logMsg := <-m.PipelineLogChan:
652: 					m.PipelineLogs = append(m.PipelineLogs, logMsg.Log)
653: 					if len(m.PipelineLogs) > 100 {
654: 						m.PipelineLogs = m.PipelineLogs[len(m.PipelineLogs)-100:]
655: 					}
656: 					if logMsg.Complete {
657: 						m.PipelineProgress = float64(logMsg.StageIndex+1) / float64(len(m.PipelineStages))
658: 						binDir, _ := embedded.GetBinDir()
659: 						nextStage := logMsg.StageIndex + 1
660: 						if nextStage < len(m.PipelineStages) {
661: 							cmds = append(cmds, m.runPipelineStage(binDir, nextStage))
662: 						} else {
663: 							cmds = append(cmds, func() tea.Msg {
664: 								return PipelineCompleteMsg{Success: true, Message: "All pipeline stages completed!"}
665: 							})
666: 						}
667: 					}
668: 					if logMsg.Error {
669: 						m.PipelineRunning = false
670: 						drained = maxDrain // Stop draining on error
671: 					}
672: 					drained++
673: 				default:
674: 					drained = maxDrain // Channel empty
675: 				}
676: 			}
677: 			cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
678: 				return pollPipelineLogsMsg{}
679: 			}))
680: 		}
681: 
682: 	case AppendChatMsg:
683: 		m.ChatHistory = append(m.ChatHistory, msg.Msg)
684: 		m.updateChatView()
685: 
686: 	case CombinedLogChatMsg:
687: 		m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, msg.Log)
688: 		GetLogger().Write(msg.Log + "\n")
689: 		if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
690: 			m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
691: 		}
692: 		m.updateLogView()
693: 		m.ChatHistory = append(m.ChatHistory, msg.Chat)
694: 		m.updateChatView()
695: 
696: 	case ProgressUpdateMsg:
697: 		m.ProgressText = msg.text
698: 		m.ProgressStatus = msg.status
699: 
700: 	case DeviceSelectedMsg:
701: 		m.DeviceIP = msg.IP
702: 		m.DeviceType = msg.DeviceType
703: 
704: 	case DiscoveryResultMsg:
705: 		// Update device info
706: 		if msg.DeviceIP != "" {
707: 			m.DeviceIP = msg.DeviceIP
708: 			m.DeviceType = msg.DevType
709: 		}
710: 		// Update logs and chat
711: 		m.ServerLogs = append(m.ServerLogs, msg.LogChat.Log)
712: 		if len(m.ServerLogs) > 50 {
713: 			m.ServerLogs = m.ServerLogs[len(m.ServerLogs)-50:]
714: 		}
715: 		m.updateLogView()
716: 		m.ChatHistory = append(m.ChatHistory, msg.LogChat.Chat)
717: 		m.updateChatView()
718: 
719: 	case ServerReadyMsg:
720: 		m.ServerReady = msg.Ready
721: 		m.ServerStarting = msg.Starting
722: 		if msg.Ready {
723: 			// Server is up — auto-dismiss the init log panel so the menu reappears
724: 			m.ShowingInitLogs = false
725: 			if msg.Port > 0 {
726: 				m.APIClient = client.NewAPIClient(msg.Port)
727: 			}
728: 		}
729: 		// Continue periodic health checks
730: 		return m, m.checkServerHealth()
731: 
732: 	case ServerCmdMsg:
733: 		m.ServerCmd = msg.Cmd
734: 		if msg.Cmd != nil && msg.Cmd.Process != nil && !m.ServerReady {
735: 			m.ServerStarting = true
736: 		}
737: 
738: 	case hideCopyNoticeMsg:
739: 		m.ShowCopyNotice = false
740: 
741: 	case textSelectedMsg:
742: 		m.SelectedText = msg.Text
743: 		if msg.Text != "" {
744: 			// Copy to clipboard
745: 			if err := clipboard.WriteAll(msg.Text); err == nil {
746: 				m.ShowCopyNotice = true
747: 				m.CopyNoticeTimer = 0
748: 				cmds = append(cmds, m.startCopyNoticeTimer())
749: 			}
750: 		}
751: 
752: 	case PipelineProgressMsg:
753: 		m.PipelineStage = msg.Stage
754: 		m.PipelineProgress = msg.Progress
755: 		if msg.Log != "" {
756: 			m.PipelineLogs = append(m.PipelineLogs, msg.Log)
757: 			if len(m.PipelineLogs) > 100 {
758: 				m.PipelineLogs = m.PipelineLogs[len(m.PipelineLogs)-100:]
759: 			}
760: 		}
761: 
762: 		if msg.Error {
763: 			m.PipelineRunning = false
764: 		} else {
765: 			binDir, _ := embedded.GetBinDir()
766: 			nextStage := msg.StageIndex + 1
767: 			if nextStage < len(m.PipelineStages) {
768: 				cmds = append(cmds, tea.Tick(50*time.Millisecond, func(t time.Time) tea.Msg {
769: 					return pollPipelineLogsMsg{}
770: 				}))
771: 				return m, m.runPipelineStage(binDir, nextStage)
772: 			}
773: 		}
774: 
775: 	case PipelineLogMsg:
776: 		m.PipelineLogs = append(m.PipelineLogs, msg.Log)
777: 		if len(m.PipelineLogs) > 100 {
778: 			m.PipelineLogs = m.PipelineLogs[len(m.PipelineLogs)-100:]
779: 		}
780: 
781: 		// Update stage name when a stage starts
782: 		if msg.Stage != "" {
783: 			m.PipelineStage = msg.Stage
784: 		}
785: 
786: 		if msg.Complete {
787: 			m.PipelineProgress = float64(msg.StageIndex+1) / float64(len(m.PipelineStages))
788: 			binDir, _ := embedded.GetBinDir()
789: 			nextStage := msg.StageIndex + 1
790: 			if nextStage < len(m.PipelineStages) {
791: 				cmds = append(cmds, m.runPipelineStage(binDir, nextStage))
792: 			} else {
793: 				cmds = append(cmds, func() tea.Msg {
794: 					return PipelineCompleteMsg{Success: true, Message: "All pipeline stages completed!"}
795: 				})
796: 			}
797: 		}
798: 		if msg.Error {
799: 			m.PipelineRunning = false

719: // monitorServerLogs monitors the server logs via SSH and handles auto-reboot scenarios
720: func (o *Orchestrator) monitorServerLogs() {
721: 	log.Printf("Starting server log monitor for device %s", o.serverDeviceIPAddr)
722: 
723: 	ticker := time.NewTicker(5 * time.Second)
724: 	defer ticker.Stop()
725: 
726: 	for {

729: 			log.Printf("Server log monitor stopped")
730: 			return
731: 		case <-ticker.C:

735: 			}
736: 
737: 			// Check for auto-reboot marker in server logs
738: 			if err := o.checkServerLogs(); err != nil {
739: 				// Only log errors occasionally to avoid spam
740: 				if o.reconnectAttempts%10 == 0 {

748: // checkServerLogs checks the server logs via SSH for auto-reboot markers
749: func (o *Orchestrator) checkServerLogs() error {
750: 	// SSH into device and tail the log file for recent entries
751: 	sshCmd := fmt.Sprintf("sshpass -p '%s' ssh -o KexAlgorithms=+diffie-hellman-group14-sha1 -o HostKeyAlgorithms=+ssh-rsa -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 root@%s "+
752: 		"\"tail -n 50 %s 2>/dev/null || echo 'LOG_FILE_NOT_FOUND'\"",
753: 		*serverSSHPassword, o.serverDeviceIPAddr, *serverLogPath)
754: 
755: 	cmd := exec.Command("sh", "-c", sshCmd)
756: 	output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
757: 	if err != nil {
758: 		return fmt.Errorf("ssh command failed: %v (output: %s)", err, string(output))
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	logOutput := string(output)
762: 
763: 	// Check for auto-reboot marker
764: 	if strings.Contains(logOutput, "AUTO_REBOOT_TRIGGERED") {
765: 		log.Printf("AUTO_REBOOT_TRIGGERED marker detected in server logs - server is rebooting")
766: 		go o.handleServerReboot()
767: 	}
768: 
769: 	return nil
770: }

772: // handleServerReboot handles the full server reboot recovery sequence
773: func (o *Orchestrator) handleServerReboot() {
774: 	o.mu.Lock()
775: 	if o.isRebooting {
776: 		o.mu.Unlock()
777: 		return // Already handling a reboot
778: 	}
779: 	o.isRebooting = true
780: 	o.mu.Unlock()
781: 
782: 	log.Printf("=== Starting server reboot recovery sequence ===")
783: 
784: 	// Step 1: Log that reboot is in progress
785: 	log.Printf("Server reboot in progress - waiting for connection to drop...")
786: 
787: 	// Step 2: Wait for connection to drop (indicating server is rebooting)
788: 	connectionDropped := o.waitForConnectionDrop(60 * time.Second)
789: 	if !connectionDropped {
790: 		log.Printf("Warning: Connection did not drop within timeout, assuming reboot is complete")
791: 	} else {
792: 		log.Printf("Connection dropped - server is rebooting")
793: 	}
794: 
795: 	// Step 3: Poll for server to come back online (retry every 5 seconds for up to 2 minutes)
796: 	log.Printf("Waiting for server to come back online...")
797: 	backOnline := o.pollForServerRecovery(120*time.Second, 5*time.Second)
798: 	if !backOnline {
799: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Server did not come back online within timeout - manual intervention required")
800: 		o.mu.Lock()
801: 		o.isRebooting = false
802: 		o.mu.Unlock()
803: 		return
804: 	}
805: 	log.Printf("Server is back online")
806: 
807: 	// Step 4: Download the server logs with timestamp
808: 	log.Printf("Downloading server logs...")
809: 	logFile, err := o.downloadServerLogs()
810: 	if err != nil {
811: 		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to download server logs: %v", err)
812: 	} else {
813: 		log.Printf("Server logs saved to: %s", logFile)
814: 	}
815: 
816: 	// Step 5: Cleanup old server process
817: 	log.Printf("Cleaning up old server process...")
818: 	if err := o.cleanupOldServerProcess(); err != nil {
819: 		log.Printf("Warning: Failed to cleanup old server process: %v", err)
820: 	}
821: 
822: 	// Step 6: Redeploy the server binary
823: 	log.Printf("Redeploying server binary...")
824: 	if err := o.redeployServerBinary(); err != nil {
825: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to redeploy server binary: %v", err)
826: 		o.mu.Lock()
827: 		o.isRebooting = false
828: 		o.mu.Unlock()
829: 		return
830: 	}
831: 	log.Printf("Server binary redeployed successfully")
832: 
833: 	// Step 7: Restart the server
834: 	log.Printf("Restarting hasher-server...")
835: 	if err := o.restartServer(); err != nil {
836: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to restart server: %v", err)
837: 		o.mu.Lock()
838: 		o.isRebooting = false
839: 		o.mu.Unlock()
840: 		return
841: 	}
842: 	log.Printf("Server restarted successfully")
843: 
844: 	// Step 8: Reconnect the ASIC client
845: 	log.Printf("Reconnecting ASIC client...")
846: 	if err := o.reconnectASICClient(); err != nil {
847: 		log.Printf("ERROR: Failed to reconnect ASIC client: %v", err)
848: 		o.mu.Lock()
849: 		o.isRebooting = false
850: 		o.mu.Unlock()
851: 		return

1002: 
1003: 	// Build server address

1007: 	backoff := 1 * time.Second
1008: 	maxBackoff := 10 * time.Second
1009: 	timeout := 60 * time.Second
1010: 	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
1011: 
1012: 	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
1013: 		client, err := asic.NewASICClient(serverAddr)

1341: // checkConnectionHealth verifies ASIC connection and attempts reconnection if needed
1342: func (o *Orchestrator) checkConnectionHealth() {
1343: 	if o.asicClient == nil {
1344: 		return
1345: 	}
1346: 
1347: 	// Try to get device info as a health check
1348: 	_, err := o.asicClient.GetDeviceInfo()
1349: 
1350: 	o.mu.Lock()
1351: 	defer o.mu.Unlock()
1352: 
1353: 	if err != nil {
1354: 		// Connection is unhealthy
1355: 		if o.connectionHealthy {
1356: 			log.Printf("ASIC connection lost: %v", err)
1357: 			o.connectionHealthy = false
1358: 		}
1359: 
1360: 		// Attempt reconnection with exponential backoff
1361: 		if o.reconnectAttempts < 5 { // Max 5 attempts before giving up temporarily
1362: 			o.reconnectAttempts++
1363: 			log.Printf("Attempting ASIC reconnection (attempt %d/5)...", o.reconnectAttempts)
1364: 
1365: 			if err := o.asicClient.Reconnect(); err != nil {
1366: 				log.Printf("Reconnection failed: %v", err)
1367: 			} else {
1368: 				log.Printf("Successfully reconnected to ASIC server")
1369: 				o.connectionHealthy = true
1370: 				o.lastHealthCheck = time.Now()
1371: 				o.reconnectAttempts = 0
1372: 			}
1373: 		} else if o.reconnectAttempts == 5 {
1374: 			log.Printf("Max reconnection attempts reached. Will retry in 60 seconds.")
1375: 			o.reconnectAttempts++ // Increment to avoid repeated log message
1376: 		} else if o.reconnectAttempts >= 11 { // Reset after ~60 seconds (6 more ticks)
1377: 			o.reconnectAttempts = 0
1378: 		} else {
1379: 			o.reconnectAttempts++
1380: 		}
1381: 	} else {
1382: 		// Connection is healthy
1383: 		if !o.connectionHealthy {
1384: 			log.Printf("ASIC connection restored")
1385: 		}
1386: 		o.connectionHealthy = true
1387: 		o.lastHealthCheck = time.Now()
1388: 		o.reconnectAttempts = 0
1389: 	}
1390: }
